input.encoding: [account_count, name_length, name_bytes..., email_count, (email_length, email_bytes...)*] using signed 64-bit values; all lengths count ASCII bytes
input.valid_component_name_rule: all accounts connected by shared emails use the same name

output.encoding: group_count u16 little-endian; for each group: name_length u16 LE, unique_email_count u16 LE, name bytes, then each email as email_length u16 LE followed by email bytes
output.ordering: groups by ASCII name, then empty-email groups before groups with emails, then first email; emails within a group in ASCII lexicographic order
